menu_option_descriptions.local: Use rooms and sensors from this Home Assistant.

local.title: Set up a local Ventilation Advisor
local.description: Give this installation a name, then select a weather provider and optionally a warning service. Rooms can be added afterwards.

remote.title: Connect a remote Ventilation Advisor
remote.description: Remote connections are deliberately limited to Tailscale addresses. Only current Ventilation Advisor snapshots are transferred; remote sensors and their history are not created in this Home Assistant. Continue first tests the connection only; it is saved after the following success confirmation.

remote_confirm.title: Connection successful
remote_confirm.description: The Tailscale connection was tested successfully. Found **{instances} installation(s)** with **{rooms} room(s)**. Submit once more to save the remote connection.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Connection successful
reconfigure_confirm.description: The updated connection details were tested successfully. Found **{instances} installation(s)** with **{rooms} room(s)**. Submit once more to save the changes.

error.not_tailscale: This address does not resolve to a recognized Tailscale connection.
error.invalid_auth: The remote Home Assistant rejected the access token.
error.cannot_connect: The remote Home Assistant cannot be reached through this Tailscale address.

abort.already_configured: This remote Home Assistant is already connected.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Indoor temperature and humidity are required. CO₂ is optional. When window/door contacts are selected, the advisor automatically recognizes airing sessions of at least 5 minutes and tracks airing history itself.

abort.already_configured: A room with this name already exists.

state.keep_open: Keep the windows open a little longer
state.can_close: You can close the windows now
state.short_observation: Open the windows briefly and keep an eye on it
state.caution_keep_closed: Better keep the windows closed for now
